items.title: Ray Ricker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 27, 2022
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe... speaking with Doctor Ray Ricker'). There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: Dr. Ricker was interviewed via Zoom on January 27, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and it’s a privilege to be speaking with Doctor Ray Ricker this afternoon. Welcome.
Thanks, Monk. Glad to talk with you.
